title: These 6 phrases are killing your ads. Swap them and watch what happens 🔥
description: These 6 phrases are killing your ads. Swap them and watch what happens 🔥
transcript: Don't say buy now. Say only four left in stock. Don't say high quality. Give proof or a guarantee. Don't just say limited time offer. Give a real time deadline and say ends on this date. Don't just say No. 1. Show customer reviews that provide undeniable proof. Don't say click here. Tell people exactly what to do next. And don't say the features. Show the benefits.
